rules.EXACT_EXTRA: Follow-up A1/A3: normalize submitted extra to the exact resolved whole-dollar charge; actual exposure and settlement use that charge.
rules.STANDARD_SCORE: Follow-up A2: score and concession comparisons use standard 16%; repetition ignores the player-uneditable extra.
rules.PROPOSAL_SPEECH: Follow-up A6: DEAL names new credit at Marcus's extra charge; ACCEPT and Marcus's replies retain exact established amounts.
rules.PUBLIC_DRAFT: Follow-up A5: public rate context contains observed interest only; blind drafts have both possible charges and no private-interest oracle.
rules.CHARGE_COPY: Follow-up A1/A4/B: exact-charge wording replaces floor/minimum/bargaining-chip wording; comparisons use 16% on the same principal.
rules.LIMIT_RESPONSE: User addition: blind charge-dependent hard limits resolve with Marcus's ordinary counter/reject response, never a validation oracle.
